assets.name: icons-barb
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production action RPG skill icon atlas for Barbarian. Create twelve entirely different premium painted fantasy skill emblems. Image is exactly a full 4 COLUMN by 3 ROW uniform grid, read LEFT TO RIGHT then TOP TO BOTTOM. Every icon centered inside its equal grid cell, each emblem fits within central 76 percent of cell leaving real transparent padding. There is NO external margin beyond this per-cell padding. All cells same size. Rich polished metal highlights, legible silhouette at 32px, dark indigo inset circular medallion with slim aged bronze rim. Each emblem vivid and unique. All surrounding space actual transparent alpha, no background or grid lines. NO text, labels, numbers, letters or watermark. Subjects by cell in exact order: 1. Cleave: a broad axe carving a crimson crescent; 2. Whirlwind: two axes within a silver spiral cyclone; 3. Charge: an armored shoulder with forward speed streaks; 4. War Cry: an open roaring mouth and amber shockwaves; 5. Ground Slam: a hammer shattering cracked ground; 6. Throwing Axes: two flying small axes crossing; 7. Iron Skin: a steel skin plate with blue highlights; 8. Rampage: a clenched red fist with jagged energy; 9. Earthquake: broken earth slabs and a glowing orange fissure; 10. Executioner: a heavy execution blade descending; 11. Blade Ward: three orbiting sharpened silver blades; 12. Berserk: a fierce horned skull burning red. Ensure all 12 cells present, no duplicated art. Consistent straight-on icon view. This is an original game art style, not copied franchise art.

assets.name: fx-barb
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent animated VFX sprite atlas for an original premium action RPG, Barbarian class. Create a landscape sprite sheet in EXACTLY 8 COLUMNS and 6 ROWS, all 48 equal cells occupy the entire image. Consistent fixed top-down three-quarter combat projection. Transparent alpha everywhere except visual effects, no backgrounds, no frames, no labels, no text, no watermark, no interface, no characters. Effects entirely contained in central 70% of each cell with transparent margin; never overlap cells. Every skill has FOUR SUCCESSIVE animation frames: anticipation, full release, impactful peak, dissipating trail. Row 1 left4cells skill1, right4cells skill2; row2 skills3/4; row3 skills5/6; row4 skills7/8; row5 skills9/10; row6 skills11/12. ALL SIX ROWS MUST APPEAR. Each four-frame sequence retains center and size with a clearly evolving shape. Readable detailed painted 2.5D fantasy spell effects, metallic blade edges or crisp magical energy, rich restrained colors, bright core and soft translucent trails. Skill sequences in exact row-major order: 1 Cleave: wide crimson steel axe crescent; 2 Whirlwind: swirling silver blades and dusty cyclone; 3 Charge: forward amber shoulder streak; 4 War Cry: expanding amber jagged sound waves; 5 Ground Slam: explosive earthen stone shards; 6 Throwing Axes: pair of spinning metal throwing axes; 7 Iron Skin: faceted blue steel protective shell; 8 Rampage: angry crimson fist sparks; 9 Earthquake: orange earth fissure and floating stones; 10 Executioner: heavy descending red execution slash; 11 Blade Ward: three rotating blue steel ward blades; 12 Berserk: fierce red lightning aura. Full grid edge-to-edge, no extra outer margin. Camera orientation stays identical for all frames. No solid rectangular cell backgrounds.

ALL neutral white and gray fog/fill/cloud/cell backdrop must become fully transparent alpha0, including inside the former rounded rectangular blocks. No shadows or floor patches. Treat this like precisely cutting out each colored subject for compositing on very dark game ground. Keep the white WOLF and white STAG subject silhouettes, but their surroundings must be empty transparent. Preserve exact original1448×1086 size and8×6cell positions/subjects/order, no new frames/art/text. Leaf, vine and insect effects keep only actual colored leaves/vines/insects and narrow colored trails; absolutely no white luminous solid mass behind them. assets.name: whirlwind
assets.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent eight-frame Whirlwind weapon cyclone animation for a premium original action RPG. EXACT 4 COLUMNS by 2 ROWS uniform full-image sprite grid, 8 equal cells, sequence left to right row1 then row2. Same fixed slightly elevated 3/4 ground projection in every frame. A dynamic cyclone of TWO spinning curved steel battleaxes around an EMPTY CENTER, multiple asymmetrical silver crescent blade trails, scattered gold sparks, airborne stone chips, smoky sand and crimson wind ribbons. Successive 8 frames visibly advance weapon angles, sweeping trails and particle positions to form a continuous rapid spin loop. Strong irregular energy, dynamic depth, varied streak lengths. NO plain full circle, no complete circular outline. No person, no body, no hero sprite, no camera rotation. Keep constant footprint and focal center at middle of each cell, entire effect within central80percent, ample real transparent alpha gutters, nothing overlaps neighboring cells. Premium sharp hand-painted 2.5D fantasy VFX, cool polished steel and warm sand with red accents. Only effects on fully transparent background. No text, numbers, grid lines, watermark or interface. All 8 frames complete and same size. Sheet occupies full image with no external border.
